subject: confused by event timing in BSM output

messages.author: cc7570824c8ba017
messages.subject: confused by event timing in BSM output
parts:
Hi BioGeoBEARS group,

I have been trying to develop rates for some transition events based on anagenetic events tables. I want to know the amount of time spent in areas being dispersed from along terminal branches that contain quite a few transition events within each simulation. Upon visual inspection I am confused. The events do not seem to naturally flow into one another on the same branch timing-wise. For example, I have two events occurring on the same terminal branch. The earliest event to occur on that branch (AB->ABC) occurred ~ 3.32 mya according to the abs_event_time column. The next most recent event (AB->ABC, again) occurred ~ 2.42 mya. Perhaps I’m missing something, using the wrong column to look at event time, or something worse, but shouldn’t the next event have started in range ABC? Any advice on how to obtain the segment length of branches spent in any particular area would be greatly appreciated! 

My model is constrained to only allow transitions into adjacent areas.

best,
Chauncey Gadek
